warnings: *** THE F16 / F18 DISCREPANCY IS RESOLVED HERE, AND F16 WINS. *** The drawing itself is titled 'F16' under the plan, its section arrows are numbered 16-16, and its pile note reads 'เสาเข็มคอนกรีตอัดแรง จำนวน 16 ต้น'. Only the TITLE BLOCK's แสดงแบบ field (and the S-01 index, which copies it) says F18. Three independent marks on the drawing against one in the title block, and F16 is also the mark actually used on the S-02 foundation plan -- so F18 is a title-block/index typo. element_id is F16; the printed F18 is preserved in this file's sheet_name and in the S-02 warning.

Sixteen piles on a plain 4 x 4 grid at 0.70 m centres, and Ø16 top AND bottom (16-Ø16 each face) -- the heaviest reinforcement of any cap in the set. It sits under column C3 at grid C-2, the only C3 on the whole foundation plan.
Cap thickness stays at 0.35 m, the same as F10 and F12, so the thickness series across the set is F3 0.20, F6 0.25, F8 0.30, F10/F12/F16 0.35 (F1 excepted -- it is a 0.80 m deep block, not a mat).

All the standard depth figures are unchanged: 1.00 from datum to cap top, 0.05 pile-head embedment, 0.30 pier, 0.10 lean-concrete projection, 0.08 lean concrete over 0.08 compacted sand. Computed pile-head level -1.30.
THE PILE-CAP SERIES IS NOW COMPLETE: F1 (S-07), F3 (S-07), F6 (S-08), F8 (S-08), F10 (S-09), F12 (S-09), F16 (S-10). Every mark used on the S-02 plan is detailed, and no detailed mark is unused.
